title: fix(types,layout,app-shell,runner)!: the console renders an app's branding.logo; the top-level logo spelling retires (objectui#10827)
body:
Fixes #10827
Clause-②: no

Related cards, referenced only: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20146 (its ledger row `app.branding.logo` flips `planned` to `live` at a later `.objectui-sha` pin; that is the PM's step and it is not done here) and objectui#10842 (the other four top-level keys `wizardDraftToAppSchema` writes).

## What this does

**The console renders `branding.logo`.** `UnifiedSidebar`, the sidebar `ConsoleLayout` mounts, reads the active app's `branding.logo` and draws it as an image in a header at the top of the sidebar. The alt text is the app's label, computed the same way as the `AppSwitcher` pill. An app without a logo gets no header, so its sidebar is byte-for-byte today's sidebar. That is the control. The header is drawn in app context only: on Home, the sidebar's `activeApp` falls back to the FIRST app, whose logo is not the screen's. This is the chrome's only reader of the key.

**One spelling.** `@objectstack/spec` declares the app logo only as `AppBrandingSchema.logo` (a URL). Its `AppSchema` alias table does not fold a top-level `logo`. It **refuses** it: measured, `AppSchema.safeParse({ name, label, logo })` answers `unrecognized_keys` with "Did you mean `logo` → `branding`?". objectui's second spelling is retired at once, with no dual-read window:
- `@object-ui/types`: `AppComponentSchema.logo` is now `never`. The zod mirror refuses a top-level `logo` by name through `aliasKeyRefusal`, with the same "Did you mean `logo` → `branding`?" lead as the spec. It is a named refusal rather than a deletion because the node is `.passthrough()`, and a deleted key would be KEPT without any error. `wizardDraftToAppSchema` no longer copies `draft.branding.logo` to the top level.
- `@object-ui/layout`: `AppSchemaRenderer`'s default sidebar header reads `schema.branding?.logo` and draws any non-empty value as an image. The old read drew an image only for values starting with `http`, so the objectstack todo example's site-relative `/assets/todo-logo.png` would have fallen through to an icon lookup. The tile's icon now comes from `schema.icon`.
- `@object-ui/runner`: `LayoutRenderer` does the same. It reads `branding.logo` as the image and takes an icon name from `icon`. It no longer guesses the kind of value from a `/` or `.`.
- Docs: `content/docs/core/app-schema.mdx` taught a top-level `logo` in two examples and its properties table. They now use `branding: { logo }`, and the table gains `icon` and `branding.logo` rows. `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md` says where the logo is drawn.

## Route change from the dispatch, with the reason (Zone 2, B3 falsified)

The dispatch's B3 suggested adding `logo` to the `AppShellBranding` object that `ConsoleLayout` builds. I measured that route and did not take it. **objectui#4818 settled that exact fork.** The maintainer ruled option 1 (remove `AppShellBranding.logo`) and explicitly rejected option 2 ("build a real branding context so sidebar/navbar can read it"). The recorded architecture is "the single real logo path stays the app schema's `branding.logo`, read directly by the sidebar". That removal shipped in 17.6.0 with the migration note "Delete the key … set it on the app schema's `branding.logo` instead". Adding the key back would have undone a settled ruling and changed a published interface twice.

The route taken is the other option both the triage and the claim offer: `UnifiedSidebar` (its header). It is the mounted successor of `AppSidebar`, the sidebar #4818 named. `AppShell.tsx` and `ConsoleLayout.tsx` are not touched. Zone 1's wording "beside the `primaryColor` that `useAppShellBranding` already carries" is read as describing where the chrome sits, not as a requirement to route the logo through `AppShellBranding`. I am naming that reading so the seat can overrule it.

**File surface outside the claim:** `packages/runner/src/LayoutRenderer.tsx`. This was forced: with `logo?: never`, its `app.logo.includes(…)` is a `tsc` error. It is the same defect class and the same move as `AppSchemaRenderer`. No open PR touches it (the file lists of the 14 open PRs were read during this run), and the gate family is the same: `type-check` plus vitest.

## Census: top-level `logo` writers and readers (the stop gate)

Read at base `8eaa1a0`, over `apps/**`, `examples/**`, `content/docs/**` and `packages/**`, excluding CHANGELOGs and locale packs.
- `logo:` key writes: 23 hits. Top-level `logo` on an app has **1 production writer, `wizardDraftToAppSchema`**, which this PR removes. The other hits are: the zod mirror's own declaration of the key (now the refusal); 2 doc examples (moved to `branding.logo`); 2 test fixtures (re-spelled); `branding.logo` writers, the positive control (`AppCreationWizard` ×2, `BrandingEditor`, `EditAppPage`'s draft, `app-creation-types` ×5); and unrelated keys (organisation logo ×2, `header-bar` ×3, a record field fixture ×2). The last hit is the CLI's own routed-project `app.json` vocabulary: a fixture `logo: 'Flame'`, typed by the CLI's local `AppConfig`, not by `AppComponentSchema`.
- ⇒ **No writer of a top-level app `logo` exists outside the wizard. The stop condition does not fire.** No writer puts an icon NAME into an `AppComponentSchema` top-level `logo` either (B2). The only icon-name `logo` is in the CLI's separate vocabulary.
- Readers of a top-level app `logo`: `AppSchemaRenderer` and the runner's `LayoutRenderer` (both moved), plus `EditAppPage`'s pre-fill fallback, which is left alone (see Acceptance notes).
- Positive control, `branding.logo` / `branding?.logo`: 11 hits on an app's branding (the designer's `AppCreationWizard` ×3 and `BrandingEditor` ×5, `EditAppPage`, `app.ts` and the console README). The same pattern also hits 6 unrelated lines: the operator's `branding.logoUrl` in `runtime-config.ts` ×4 and the embeddable form's own `branding.logo` ×2.
- objectstack `examples/` at `origin/main` `733822cf`, read-only: 0 top-level app `logo`. `branding.logo` has one hit, in `app-todo`'s `todo.app.ts`, inside `branding` (the control). The `app-crm` and `app-showcase` apps declare `branding` with a colour only.

## Verification: all at `6ea8f67`

- Pins, new:
  - `ConsoleLayout.appBrandingLogo-10827.test.tsx` mounts the real `ConsoleLayout`, the real `AppShell` and the real `UnifiedSidebar` under the real `NavigationProvider`. It checks four cases. A branded app shows its logo, named by its label. **CONTROL:** an app without a logo shows no image. An app with only a top-level `logo` shows nothing. The active app wins over the first app. Separately, Home context draws no logo.
  - `AppSchemaRenderer.brandingLogo-10827.test.tsx`: relative, absolute and `data:` URLs are drawn. The CONTROL shows no image and the default icon. The retired key is drawn neither as an image nor as an icon name.
  - `LayoutRenderer.brandingLogo-10827.test.tsx` (runner): the same three cases, with `Box` as the control.
  - `app-logo-one-spelling-10827.test.ts` (types): a named refusal at path `logo` with code `invalid_type`, whatever the value. The TypeScript face refuses the key (`@ts-expect-error`). The wizard output has no `logo` key and parses green through the refusing mirror. A spec control shows the spec refuses the top-level key and accepts `branding.logo`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/layout/ packages/runner/`: `Test Files 282 passed (282)`, `Tests 5682 passed (5682)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/layout/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/`: `Test Files 48 passed (48)`, `Tests 626 passed (626)`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/types --filter @object-ui/layout --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/runner run type-check`: each script echoed (`packages/X type-check$ tsc --noEmit && … tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), and each ends `Done`. The command exited 0. This ran after a turbo build of the dependency closure: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`. `--listFiles` confirms that each package's `tsconfig.test.json` contains its new test.
- **Reverse verification (cross-package type):** a temporary `runner/src` probe wrote `{ type: 'app', logo: '/x.svg' }`. The runner's `tsc --noEmit` exited 2 with `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'`, which proves the runner reads the rebuilt `dist/app.d.ts`. The probe was removed and `git status` is clean.
- **Ablation of the chrome reader** (`ablation-replace.mjs`, commit first, WRAP mode): `activeApp?.branding?.logo` was changed to `activeApp?.logo`, with anchor count 1 → 0 and blob `0ef580a5b1b1` → `0b4febdb08ed`. The console pin went `3 failed | 2 passed (5)`: the branded app, the alias and the active-app cases failed, and the CONTROL and Home cases stayed green, which is the expected direction. The restore was `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`: blob == HEAD (`0ef580a5b1b1`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Docs control:** the `app-schema.mdx` example was put back to the top-level `logo` through the same tool. `pnpm check:doc-snippets` then failed with `content/docs/core/app-schema.mdx … TS2322` (`678 of 678 block(s) judged, 1 failed`), and the restore was proven the same way. At HEAD: `678 of 678 block(s) judged, 0 failed`.
- Gates at HEAD, all exit 0:
  - `check-changeset-presence` (`12 source file(s) of 4 released package(s) changed … declares 1 changeset(s)`), `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`.
  - `check:changeset-claims`: 12 pending changesets name files touched here, and each paragraph was read. None is falsified: none speaks of the app logo.
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`.
  - `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `docs:check-links`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 15 paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- **Lint, a declared narrowing:**
  - Population: every package's `lint` is `eslint .`, and the rule-bearing config objects match `**/*.{ts,tsx}`.
  - Counted: `eslint --format json` over the 12 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files gives `12` files, `0` errors and 18 warnings, and 0 of those warnings fall on an added line.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off, and no custom rule reads the disk. This diff therefore cannot move a verdict on a file it does not touch.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - The rest of `packages/app-shell`: the whole-package run passed the 590 s foreground cap and was stopped. The layout directory and the source scans were run. The rest is left to CI.
  - The rendered sidebar in a real browser. The layout is Tailwind utilities only (`h-8 w-auto max-w-full object-contain`).
  - Whether the wizard's save door (`client.meta.saveItem`) refuses the other four top-level keys. That is objectui#10842.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10827-app-branding-logo-one-spelling.md` bumps `@object-ui/types` **minor**, with the break stated: `AppComponentSchema.logo` is `never` and refused by name. `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/runner` are **patch**, because no published prop moves. It names the published 17.6.0 changelog sentence that is now false: the one saying the top-level `logo` is "rendered directly by `AppSchemaRenderer`'s default sidebar header".

## Acceptance notes (not filed, per the dispatch's scope rules)

- `EditAppPage`'s pre-fill still reads `appToEdit.branding?.logo || appToEdit.logo`. That is a consumer-side fallback onto the retired spelling. Its `{ ...appToEdit, ...appSchema }` merge also passes a stored top-level `logo` through on save. The claim fences `plugin-designer`, and this is not needed for compilation (`appToEdit` is `any`), so it is left for the card that edits that file next. The `favicon` twin sits on the adjacent line. Carrier: objectui#10842.
- `favicon` has the same two spellings (B5), and they are not changed here. Census at base:
  - Top-level writers: `wizardDraftToAppSchema` (the only production writer), 2 doc examples, and 1 test fixture.
  - Top-level readers: `AppSchemaRenderer` (it feeds `AppShell`'s favicon from `schema.favicon` and never reads `branding.favicon`) and `EditAppPage`'s fallback.
  - `branding.favicon` readers: `ConsoleLayout` into `useAppShellBranding` (live in the console), the designer's editors, and `EditAppPage`.
  - The spec refuses a top-level `favicon` (`unrecognized_keys`). Carrier: objectui#10842.
- The CLI's routed-project scaffold reads its own `app.json`'s `logo` as an icon name, in its generated layout. That vocabulary is separate (a local `AppConfig` with `title` / `logo` / `menu`), is not validated against `AppComponentSchema`, and has no in-tree producer beyond its test fixture. It is untouched.
- UX placement: the logo sits at the top of the sidebar, not in the top bar. The top bar's leftmost tile is the operator's platform logo (`getLogoUrl()`), which already takes the app's `primaryColor` through `bg-primary`.
